description: Send take_message, check_availability, book or book_first_available (data.options: up to 5 {date, after, before, service} windows in order; fallback take_message or none) through Odile Direct. No sign-in: free with IP caps. Signed in: first 50 completed tasks/account/calendar month free, then delivered message 1 credit, availability 0, confirmed booking 5 (a first-available request that leaves a message instead costs 1). Uses the same Direct credits as REST, separate from phone minutes. Keep message_id unchanged on retry. One keyed task/account at a time. For free listings set target=claim and biz to its /c/ card ID: messages only, email, 20/day for everyone. Returns the A2A v1.0 {task}. Disclose automation and obtain permission before booking. A deposit-required booking returns INPUT_REQUIRED with a payment_url for the human; it is pending for 30 minutes and confirmed only after payment. Deposit bookings use no Direct credits. Directory REST skill call_business requires a signed-in developer API key and explicit account enablement: US/Canada landline only, weekdays 09:00–17:00 locally, disclosure first, no sales, opt-out forever; 10 credits per completed call and zero for rejected/no-answer. It never calls a business with an Odile structured channel.
name: send_to_business
title: Send a business a message or booking
